findings.title: Encrypted-to-encrypted v3 domain change is rewritten into DROP+ADD, losing ciphertext
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Same source-type-blind mechanism, confirmed in rewrite-migrations.ts and the codec.ts jsonb-domain comment. A domain-to-domain change is rewritten into a destructive DROP.

findings.title: Loud migrate failure on populated v3 tables becomes silent plaintext loss
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The head v3 migration path auto-rewrites to destructive SQL, logs at info level, and still tells the user to run drizzle-kit migrate, so a loud failure on a populated table becomes data loss.

findings.title: Sweep rewrites historical, already-applied migrations in the out directory
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The newly wired v3 sweep rewrites every .sql in outDir except the generated file, without checking the journal. Because v3 targets now match, already-applied jsonb/v3-source ALTERs can have their committed history edited.
